claim.why_it_matters: The heading is invisible to the outline and to any tool that locates clauses by heading, so citations to §1985:IX.1.3.x cannot be resolved to this text by structure.
claim.detail: Numbered subsection heading demoted to a plain paragraph line (no heading marker); its sibling 1.3.6 on page 477 is `### 1.3.6 The At End Condition`.

verdict.reasoning: The printed page (IX-6, Indexed I-O) shows '1.3.5 The Invalid Key Condition' as a numbered subsection heading on its own line. The transcription (specs/ANSI_COBOL_1985.md line 18606, page-476.md line 9) carries the text verbatim but as a plain paragraph with no heading marker, while its sibling in the same module (line 18634) is '### 1.3.6 The At End Condition' and the parallel Relative I-O module marks '### 1.3.5 The Invalid Key Condition' (line 17316). The words are not missing; only the heading markup is, so it is a structural (outline) defect, not a content change. Noted in passing: '1.3.4 I-O Status' at line 18464 in the same module is also a plain line (outside this claim's page).
